name: Physical Appearance
overview: Scripture reveals that human physical appearance is rooted in being made in the image and likeness of God, as stated in Genesis 1:26-27. While the body is part of this creation, Matthew 16:26 reminds believers that the value of a person surpasses outward gain and centers on the soul. Romans 12:1 calls Christians to present their bodies as living sacrifices, emphasizing holiness and dedication to God rather than conforming to worldly standards, further supported by the transformation described in Romans 12:2. The Christian community is also encouraged to receive others with grace, focusing on faith rather than external differences, as indicated in Romans 14:1.
